signature:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TagClusterResult:
    assignments: pd.DataFrame
    cluster_labels: dict[int, str]
    cluster_members: dict[int, list[str]]
    cooccurrence: pd.DataFrame
    method: str
    params_used: dict
docstring:
Outcome of one cluster_tags call.

Attributes:
    assignments: A DataFrame with columns appid, cluster_id -- one row per game that had at least one retained tag, per the module's own edge case 'Games carrying no tags at all -> excluded from clustering'. A game whose tags span multiple clusters is assigned to the cluster its PLURALITY of tags belongs to (ties broken by lowest cluster_id, for determinism).
    cluster_labels: cluster_id -> label string from label_cluster.
    cluster_members: cluster_id -> list of tag strings belonging to that cluster.
    cooccurrence: The raw tag-by-tag co-occurrence count matrix (not the Jaccard distance matrix) used for labeling and available for reporting/debugging.
    method: Fixed string 'agglomerative_jaccard_no_genre_anchor', recorded for traceability into analysis_results['tag_clusters'] since the method itself is locked but implementation details (linkage, threshold) may still evolve.
    params_used: {'linkage': ..., 'distance_threshold': ..., 'threshold_source': 'frozen' | 'run_local_search'} -- records whether AnalysisParams.tag_distance_threshold was used verbatim (frozen) or derived fresh by this run's own search (run_local_search, only possible pre-freeze).
postconditions: Every appid in assignments has a cluster_id present as a key in both cluster_labels and cluster_members
cluster_members' lists partition the set of tags that survived filtering (every retained tag belongs to exactly one cluster)

edge_cases.input: A game with tags split evenly across two clusters (plurality tie)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: assigned to the lower-numbered cluster_id, deterministically

edge_cases.input: Zero games have any retained tags at all
edge_cases.expected_behavior: assignments is an empty DataFrame with the correct columns; cluster_labels/cluster_members are empty dicts

unit_tests.name: test_every_assigned_game_has_valid_cluster_id
unit_tests.description: For a synthetic fixture, every cluster_id in assignments is a key in cluster_labels.

unit_tests.name: test_plurality_tie_broken_by_lowest_id
unit_tests.description: A game with tags evenly split between cluster 2 and cluster 5 is assigned to cluster 2.
